conventions.problem_id:
boundary///

: P congruent pieces on the boundary of a convex 4-polytope; polytope tesseract; piece ball (unit 3-ball, radius 1) or cube (unit cube, edge 1)
conventions.score: s, the polytope's edge (smaller is better)
conventions.cells: the tesseract is [-s/2, s/2]^4; cell 2 i + (sigma > 0) is the cube x_i = sigma s/2 (i = 0..3, sigma = -1 or +1)
conventions.pose: {cell, u, q?}: u = the centre in the cell's local coordinates at s (the other three R^4 coordinates in increasing order, the cell's centre at the origin), in the closed cell; q = rotation (unit quaternion w, x, y, z) of a cube in that frame, absent = axis-aligned; balls have no q
conventions.validity: fold placement: each piece is developed from its centre across 2-faces; no point of the edges or vertices in a piece's interior; developments injective on interiors; interiors of distinct pieces disjoint (touching allowed)
conventions.certified_statement: config is at s = score_cert; python/boundary/certify.py proves it strictly valid in exact rational arithmetic (closed pieces avoid the edges and vertices, are embedded and pairwise disjoint)
conventions.score_cert: s lam_k for the first k >= 1 with lam_k = 1 + k 1e-12 at which the scaled configuration (s lam_k, u lam_k, binary64 products) certifies; score_float = the unscaled s
conventions.certificate: the certifier's exact margins at score_cert, rounded down to binary64: balls min_clearance (to the edges), min_distance (over the pairs at most 2 apart in R^4; null when there is none, so all centres are more than 2 apart), min_loop (null: no geodesic loop shorter than 2 s); cubes min_edge_slack (per cube the second smallest of h - |u_l| - 1/2 over its three axes, positive when it crosses faces in at most one axis and keeps clear of the edges; least over the cubes) and min_part_separation (per pair of parts in one cell the largest gap over the axes; least over the pairs); k and lambda of the scaling
conventions.exact: where present, an exact construction valid at exactly its s (touching allowed), checked by the certifier in records mode: field Q (numbers or rational strings) or Q(sqrt 2, sqrt 3) (each number [a, b, c, d] = a + b sqrt 2 + c sqrt 3 + d sqrt 6); config is its binary64 rounding, scaled to strict validity
conventions.previous: where the record improves on the research prototype's round-2 value: that value certified the same way, and improvement_rel = 1 - score_cert / previous.score_cert
conventions.display: score_cert rounded to the nearest at 6 decimals (half-even, from its exact binary64 value)
conventions.bound: the larger proven lower bound on s: volume, or one piece (sqrt 2 for balls, 1/sqrt 2 for cubes), as a binary64 value rounded down
conventions.nofold: the best value when every piece must lie in one closed cell: f(ceil(P/8)), the smallest cube holding ceil(P/8) pieces
conventions.status: best_known everywhere: PolyPack calls a value proven only with a published proof
